description: Drive the character's own body: set her facial expression, fire a celebration effect, play a pose/animation, or move her around (walk left/right, jump, stand still, go idle, skateboard, parachute). Use whenever the user tells her to DO something or FEEL something - 'dance for me', 'look happy', 'cheer', 'walk over to the left', 'give me a heart', 'be surprised', 'do a happy dance', 'go back to standing'. Pick the kind first, then a name from that kind's list; informal words are fine (hearts, yay, poof, rope, sleepy, sad). One behaviour per call. NOT for playing music or video (that is play_song / play_movie), and not for the character's own spoken reply.

params.name: kind
params.description: Which part of her to drive: expression (her face only), event (a timed effect like hearts or confetti), action (a full-body animation she performs), or move (where she goes). Informal spellings work too: expr/face/mood, fx/effect, act/pose, motion.

params.name: name
params.description: What to do. expression: happy, wink, sad, thinking, anxious, angry, surprised, sleepy, fear, disgust, contempt, confused, skeptical, embarrassed, neutral, adore. event: love, idea, celebration, sleep, peace, disappear, appear, halloween, matrix, magic, robot. action: skip, juggle, dance, eat, work, guitar, sneeze, sixseven, basketball, drive, ride, kitten, wave. move: 'left', 'right', 'walk', 'jump', 'stand', 'idle', 'skateboard', 'parachute'. Informal words are fine (hearts, yay, poof, rope, sleepy) and underscores work instead of spaces (walk_left).
